description: Pans one signal around four quadraphonic outputs from an on-screen joystick, a pair of control voltages, or both together

params.text: Re-centres the joystick for as long as it is held down

inputs.text: The signal panned to the four outputs; it is read as one channel, so a polyphonic cable into it is reduced to its first channel
Moves the pan left and right, added to the joystick position; 5V reaches the right edge from the centre and -5V the left
Moves the pan front and back, added to the joystick position; 5V reaches the front from the centre and -5V the rear

outputs.text: The input at the level the pan position gives the front left corner
The input at the level the pan position gives the front right corner
The input at the level the pan position gives the surround left corner
The input at the level the pan position gives the surround right corner
A four-channel polyphonic copy of the outputs, in the order front left, front right, surround left, surround right

notes: the pan law is close to constant power rather than the usual pan pot: halfway in one direction is about 3dB down, and the centre of the circle is about 6dB down in all four outputs
the joystick is one custom widget rather than a parameter, so it cannot be clicked for help; drag inside the circle to pan
hold P and click near the rim of the joystick circle to snap the position to the blue arrow nearest the click
the joystick position and the two control voltages are added and then clamped, so a voltage can push a centred stick fully to one side and a deflected stick no further
